response.title: Aakhri Chitthi: Why Did She Leave?
response.hook: If I told you, you'd hate someone else instead of me. I chose me.
response.positioning: A sibling showdown over a secret that one of them has kept for six years.
response.rationale: Recorded plan: fast cuts between conflict beats, ending on the strongest emotional line.
